title: Radio group
summary: One value chosen from a set of radios; the group owns the value, the name and the validity.

examples.label: A wrapping row
examples.subject: component:radio-group
examples.markup: <ui-radio-group label="Quiet hours" orientation="horizontal" value="night"><ui-radio value="off">Off</ui-radio><ui-radio value="night">Nights, 22–07</ui-radio><ui-radio value="weekend">Weekends</ui-radio></ui-radio-group>

examples.label: Required, with a disabled option
examples.subject: component:radio-group
examples.markup: <ui-field label="Size"><ui-radio-group name="size" required><ui-radio value="s">Small</ui-radio><ui-radio value="m">Medium</ui-radio><ui-radio value="l" disabled>Large (sold out)</ui-radio></ui-radio-group></ui-field>
